responsibility: This file implements the helper that drives GCC’s backend RTL pass pipeline starting from an already existing RTL function. It sets up pass_startwith and max_regno, performs minimal backend initialization that expand/cgraphunit would normally provide such as section switching, debug assembly start, scheduler-attribute and bitmap-obstack setup, runs either the remaining compilation passes or just the clean-slate pass list, and then marks the function as having RTL. Its responsibility is direct invocation of the RTL pipeline for front-end, selftest, or dump-reload workflows rather than normal end-to-end compilation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the run_rtl_passes helper by performing the backend setup and executing the remaining or clean-slate RTL pass lists on an existing cfun; the header only exposes that single entry point.
